name: Tribosys 3204 Switch Lubricant
sourceText:
TriboSys 3204 is a semi-fluid grease that is most commonly used exclusively to lube tactile switches. Like the popular Krytox variants, the TriboSys variant of lubes is used by mechanical keyboard enthusiasts on their switches. 3204 has medium-thickness when it is compared to TriboSys 3203.
Sold in:
3ml
5ml
3ml is enough for around 300 switches if using a thin coat.
5ml is enough for about 500 switches if using a thin coat.
We do not accept returns for lubricants as it would be impossible to guarantee they were not tampered with, contaminated, or stored improperly.
***Disclaimer***
Lubricant can not be cleaned with soap and water and is resistant to many solvents.
Although the lubricant is chemically stable and non-hazardous please wear gloves and place a protective layer of drop-plastic below any working surface. Spills are difficult to clean, and the lubricant will transfer from an operator's hands to any surface they may touch.
Please clean up any accidents with a microfiber cloth.
KeebsForAll is not responsible for any damages which occur as a result of untrained or unsupervised use. This chemical is for industrial use only.

name: Krytox 206g0 Switch Lubricant
sourceText:
Typically, lubing any MX variant switch will greatly increase the quality of the switch's sound profile as well as typing feel. Most enthusiasts would not use switches on their keyboards unless they're lubed.
Video Guide on Switch Lube Application:
Brandon Taylor (Youtube)
The Krytox GPL206g0 grease is a thicker variant of the Krytox 205g0. Due to the thickness, Krytox 206g0 is a great choice for lubing stabilizers. Krytox 206g0 can be lubed with switches as well, but due to thickness of the lube do not overlube your switches. We sell the grease in both 3ml and 5ml variants.
3ml is enough for around 300 switches if using a thin coat.
5ml is enough for about 500 switches if using a thin coat.
In general, one should consider "less is more" when lubing with 206g0. Over application of the grease will cause poor sound and typing feel on switches.
We do not accept returns for lubricants as it would be impossible to guarantee they were not tampered with, contaminated, or stored improperly.
***Use Warning***
Lubricant can not be cleaned with soap and water and is resistant to many solvents.
Although the lubricant is chemically stable and non-hazardous please wear gloves and place a protective layer of drop-plastic below any working surface. Spills are difficult to clean, and the lubricant will transfer from an operator's hands to any surface they may touch.
Please clean up any accidents with a microfiber cloth.
KeebsForAll is not responsible for any damages which occur as a result of untrained or unsupervised use. This chemical is for industrial use only.

Wuque Onion switches are linear switches, featuring polycarbonate top housing, nylon bottom housing, and POM stem. WS Onion Switches are now available at KeebsForAll after one year development with JWK!
Wuque Onion Switches Specification:
Top Housing: PC
Bottom Housing: Nylon
Stem: Pom
Spring: Wuque Studio WS CL635 Gold Plated Stainless Spring
Spring Weight: 63.5g
Manufactured by JWK
Factory Lube
Note: please use Kailh switch opener to open it.
It is sold in quantities of 1 switch.
Hear it before you buy

sourceText:
M0110 by Vortexkeyboard.
Vortexkeyboard, finally, releasing the M0110, which is a retro APPLE computer keyboard. To keep at that "retro" aspect, there will only be one color, which is beige.
*This kit does not include the required 1.5V AA Batteries (2), you must acquire on your own.*
M0110 6.25 also offers you the option for 7U spacebar, which the bottom row will be: 1.5U, 1U, 1.5U, 7U. But in this case, you would need to provide your own stabilizers and keycaps.
*Actual products may vary due to product enhancement, all pictures shown are for illustration purposes*

name: OwLab London Fog Linear Switches
sourceText:
OwLab London Fog Linear Switches
Latest linear switches from OwLab! Yet again, with a pretty solid factory lube and smooth typing experience!
Offering in lubed. Produced from one of the OGs, BSUN.
OwLab London Fog Linear Switches Specifications:
Polycarbonate housings
UPE material for long-pole stems
Total travel of 3.6mm
55g Actuation
60g Bottom Out
Spring Length of 20mm
Factory Lubed
Linear
Manufactured by BSUN
Quick UnBoxing and Review by DrHey
// YouTube video london fog switches from OWLAB Watch on YouTube
Here is a guide on how many switches you'll need for different keyboard sizes (The guide is a reference, but some keyboards market a certain layout even though they require a few more or fewer switches. Always order a few more if you're unsure):
120 - full size
92 - TKL
80 - 75%
70 - 65%
65 - 60%
45 - 40%
Selling in quantities of 1.

name: kfaPBT Pink Robin Keycaps
sourceText:
We are excited to introduce the in-stock kfaPBT keysets, featuring crisp and clear colors, 1.5mm keycap thickness, and various designs at affordable prices. So that you can customize your keyboard the way you want, without waiting long lead-times & without breaking the bank!
Pink Robin Keycaps are one of the first sets we are releasing under the kfaPBT. Inspired from KFA's Pink Robin Switches & Deskmats.
Specifications:
PBT
Dye-Sub & Reverse Dye-Sub
Cherry Profile
1.5mm Keycap Thickness
By KeebsForAll
Base Kit with Numpad & Extra Modifiers
Compatibility:
Can fit 60%-100% keyboards
